QorCap v0.3.43: practice live tap with Live Weave cues (default off)

`receipt.v0.json` is unchanged.

- Practice live tap (#146): with `QORCAP_LIVE_TAP=udp://127.0.0.1:1937` and `QORCAP_LANE=practice` (or `--live-tap ... --practice-lane`), QorCap stays the only reader of the capture card and also sends the MPEG-TS bytes it records to a loopback UDP port. Every 15 frames it adds a timed-ID3 Live Weave cue: frame index, QorCap clock, session seal state, newest controller press, chained by hash. Cues are also logged to `live_weave.jsonl`.
- Refused outside the practice lane and for any non-loopback target. Off by default.
- The recording, the hash chain, `verify-bundle` and the receipt are unchanged. Timing line-up only; it does not say who holds the controller.
- Practice only: not sent, no referee submit. REAL MATCH users can stay on their current build.
